boundary_reduction_scope: Entire physically protected decision source is paid pointwise. Full arithmetic raw criterion is equivalent to the remaining signed incidence/clearance correction, not yet proved.
common_pointwise_return_correction_scope: The legacy false flag concerns central-scale smallness of the full signed raw correction, not existence of the new count-compatible finite measure.
complete_correction_scope: Localized intrinsic power-logarithm germs of whole actual label components; absolute TV convergence with any prescribed positive mass budget and exact cutoff compatibility. Not summability of the old unlocalized exponential word jets.
complete_height_scope: Full collision roof law and every bounded actual-return restriction have a radius-uniform exponential-in-count height bound; not an m^-2 asymptotic.
conditional_bridge_scope: Original exact K_n=k, N_n=m event with fixed positive roof interval; uniform for central targets with m^2 times the original probability bounded below. This denominator is verified on each fixed-radius positive arithmetic class.
continuous_germ_scope: All positive-exponent component germs through exponent one admit any prescribed summed supremum budget by support localization, retaining coefficients. Finite jumps and the residual inverse are not made small by this construction.
critical_cluster_scope: Original exact labels; epsilon-protected margins epsilon*(47/53)^(distance-to-endpoints/4), fixed epsilon before m tends to infinity; intrinsic coincident atoms and every shrinking physical roof-excess collar are o(m^-2). Not a full boundary-source or signed-correction theorem.
critical_collar_geometry: Endpoint radius r_* epsilon^3; roof width h_* epsilon^6; relative density ratio e^-1 to e; constants independent of word length.
decision_density_scope: Physically protected H^eta(1-D^epsilon) at every depth; exact original labels; normalized limsup C M epsilon^(1/16). Uniform finite-count error permits summed depths and J(m) at fixed eta,epsilon.
endpoint_boundary_scope: All physical incidence/clearance and retained middle-decision margins fixed protected; no protection on free endpoint decisions. For fixed eta,epsilon,J, normalized exact-index density limsup <= C M(J+1)epsilon. Thresholds may depend on fixed parameters. Bounded measurable weights by domination.
exact_return_index_Gaussian_asymptotic_s: Legacy false flag refers to the unmodulated radius-uniform target; the fixed-radius arithmetic interval theorem has its own true flag.
finite_count_BV_scope: Uniform in radius for the unweighted source and a specified jointly subanalytic finite-record family; no effective long-time growth estimate and no BV claim for arbitrary measurable weights.
finite_packet_scope: A fixed finite packet of length lcm(1,...,D_0); not a replacement for an arbitrary prescribed exact index.
first_bad_margin_scope: Positive disjoint first-defect incidence/clearance/interior-decision sources. Bounds epsilon^2, epsilon, epsilon*q^((J+1)/4) are variation masses only. Their signed pointwise sum remains unproved.
guarded_packet_scope: Full finite actual-return packet under conservative guards; no separate normal-strip deletion. Coefficient stabilization requires positive margins for every guard factor. The omitted density has a mass bound, not a pointwise bound.
legacy_interior_flag_scope: The false old interior-decision flag concerns the entire old first-bad-middle source, which can have later physical defects. Those histories are retained in the new physical remainder.
new_phase_posterior_scope: At fixed radius on positive arithmetic classes under unchanged exact K,N and a fixed positive roof interval; no phase-indicator multiplier assumption and no claim of radius-uniform phase labels.
ordered_all_decision_scope: epsilon(B)=A B^(-1/12) fixed before the collision limsup; paid protected and all-depth decision correction O(B^(-1/192)); no useful growth bound on auxiliary spectral constants.
ordered_endpoint_scope: epsilon(B)=A B^(-1/12), J(B)=floor(B^(1/24)), both fixed before m tends to infinity. Protected plus endpoint signed correction O(B^(-1/24)); not a prescribed count-dependent rate.
ordered_protection_scope: epsilon(B)=A B^-1/12 is fixed in each collision limsup. The complementary original source has O(B^-1/12) total mass, not proved pointwise small.
pointwise_boundary_source_bound_scope: Any bounded measurable source restriction is dominated at fixed collision count by C A^m; no central-scale smallness follows.
pointwise_reconstruction_scope: Sum of labelwise essential-supremum errors <= delta using actual component A2 and mass-dependent bandwidths. No density-LLT rate or growing-band spectral estimate.
protected_all_band_scope: Convolution inequality for a source part already pointwise small; not a growing-band spectral bound.
protected_complete_scope: For the explicit smooth guard: collision-limsup signed correction O((M+L) B^-1/2) at each fixed B>=C epsilon^-12; for fixed epsilon it vanishes for every B_m tending to infinity, with no m rate.
regular_derivative_scope: Actual W1,infinity density with Q_m(h) retained at finite m; h=c epsilon^3 delta^2 fixed before collision limit; no word-count or unestimated W21 derivative sum.
shrinking_interval_scope: A common existentially slow interval sequence, not a prescribed polynomial scale or pointwise density.
transition_scope: Evaluated finite Gaussian peak sum, uniform through parameter transitions; not a claim that every arithmetic factor equals one.
weighted_protected_scope: Protected regular source still requires endpoint-gradient budget. New all-depth decision source allows arbitrary bounded measurable insertions; physical remainder still required at same roof value.
